about: Scott N. Brown attended law school and graduated from Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad College of Law in 2003. Scott Brown began practicing law in 2003.
Scott Brown is an attorney at Bast Amron LLP, helping people with Bankruptcy: Business issues. Bast Amron LLP has an office in Miami, Florida, serving the local community.

Scott Brown was selected to Super Lawyers for 2015 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
